description: Transform static SVG images or maps into dynamic, data-driven visuals with Synoptic Panel by OKVIZ. This powerful custom visual for Power BI allows you to layer interactive data over any image, shape, or geographical map, giving your reports richer context and deeper insight. From process flows to floor plans, manufacturing lines to organizational charts—Synoptic Panel helps you seamlessly drill down into your data and uncover actionable findings faster. Key Features Multi-Level Navigation Dive deeper into your data by drilling through multiple hierarchy levels. Associate different maps or diagrams at each level for expanded, context-rich insights. Flexible Map Loading Load maps from local files, remote URLs, or dedicated storage for maximum convenience and scalability. My Storage Store your maps in a dedicated cloud storage, making it easy to access and share your visuals across reports. Batch Loading Easily import large sets of remote maps at once, streamlining setup for complex reporting environments. Map Filtering Use Power BI filters to control which map (or portion of a map) displays, enabling highly targeted and dynamic views. Extreme Customization Tailor colors, shapes, legends, and more—plus apply Power BI conditional formatting to highlight trends or thresholds right on your maps.
